On entry I had no brain directives, no brain status file, and no research findings file. The last successful brain run was run-282 on 2026-05-14 12:10 EDT, so the brain has been silent for about 3.4 days, covering roughly thirteen daily fires at the new 04:00 cadence. The bot itself stayed mechanically alive across that window (heartbeat 28 minutes stale on entry, events log scanning live, cycle 12 on PID 3032), but no new closed trades — the trade log mtime is still pinned at 2026-05-13 23:35 EDT.
